services.title: OpenStreetMap
services.description: The standard map of OpenStreetMap, the free map of the world made by its contributors. Data under the Open Database Licence. The tile servers are run by volunteers on donated resources: browse, but don't download areas in bulk.

services.title: OpenTopoMap
services.description: A topographic map with contour lines and hill shading, drawn from OpenStreetMap and SRTM elevation data. CC BY-SA.
services.attribution: Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, SRTM | Map style: © OpenTopoMap (CC-BY-SA)

services.title: USGS The National Map: imagery
services.description: Aerial and satellite imagery of the United States from the US Geological Survey, with Blue Marble for the rest of the world. Public domain.

services.title: NASA GIBS: Blue Marble with bathymetry
services.description: NASA's Blue Marble of the whole Earth, with shaded relief on land and the depths of the sea, from the Global Imagery Browse Services. Nothing within 5° of the poles.

services.title: EMODnet Bathymetry
services.description: Depths of the European seas and the oceans from the European Marine Observation and Data Network, as a coloured base map. CC BY 4.0. Not for navigation.
